# orbivisor_folder (Data Source)

A folder managed elsewhere (to put objects in by path).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `path` (String) Path, e.g. `/prod/web`.

### Optional

- `kind` (String) Tree: `vm` (default), `network` or `storage`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `key` (String) Manifest key `tree:/path` (also a grant target).
- `quota` (Dynamic)
